aggregation.categorical_features: none selected; any future categorical addition requires unanimous value and a new registration
aggregation.feature_conflict: nonfinite values are missing, not zero; conflicting required nonnumeric or timing values block the fold
aggregation.feature_missing: if some member values are missing, average all finite values and record finite/missing counts; if every member is missing, emit group-level missing and impute using the training-fold median for that feature
aggregation.identifiers_and_timestamps: never averaged; required values must be unanimous and identifiers remain provenance only
aggregation.multiplicity: one group is one example and receives training weight 1.0 regardless of member count
aggregation.numeric_features: for each selected feature, arithmetic mean of all finite member values available by the unanimous feature cutoff; binary indicators therefore become member fractions
aggregation.outcome: arithmetic mean of finite saved gross split-adjusted return_5d across every canonical member with equal observation weight; any missing/nonfinite member outcome blocks the affected fold

claim_limits: exploratory and informed by viewed development results
ticker is an operational group identifier, not verified security continuity
gross endpoint arithmetic is not net profitability or portfolio performance
no independent-row inference or uncertainty interval
historical coverage, terminal valuation, applicable development costs, and broader validation remain unresolved

development_screen.disclosure: all fold differences, selected absolute returns, baseline absolute returns, losses, counts, and denominators
development_screen.fold_rule: selected_minus_baseline > 0 in at least 2 of 3 folds
development_screen.interpretation: passing supports further research only; it does not establish significance, positive profitability, out-of-sample superiority, or promotion readiness

eligibility.difference: training outcomes are available only inside the training partition for fitting; validation outcomes remain hidden until frozen predictions and membership are persisted
eligibility.evaluation: all groups wholly assigned to that fold's validation IDs under the same fixed rules
eligibility.failure: missing required evidence, invalid timing, incompatible group membership, or missing required outcome blocks the fold; no silent exclusion
eligibility.model_independence: old predictions, selections, abstention, risk_rejected, and rule_rejected flags are not eligibility inputs
eligibility.training: all groups wholly assigned to that fold's training IDs that satisfy fixed canonical, timing, feature-availability, and group-integrity rules

evaluation.blocked_fold: retain fold with explicit reason and make aggregate NOT_EVALUABLE; never average surviving folds
evaluation.cohort_aggregation: equal weight across every compatible cohort within fold
evaluation.fold_aggregation: equal weight 1/3 across folds 1, 2, and 3 only when all are complete
evaluation.missing_outcome: block affected fold without reselection, row dropping, substitution, or renormalization
evaluation.primary: selected equal-weight gross endpoint return minus eligible-cohort equal-weight gross endpoint return

features.availability: each value must satisfy the saved feature cutoff/source timestamp contract; outcomes cannot resolve feature conflicts
excluded: historical model scores, predictions, selections, and gates

future_capture_contract.ordering: model, fold, cohort key, ticker, stable_group_identity
future_capture_contract.pre_outcome_capture: persist predictions, group mappings, eligibility, and hashes before reading validation returns

group_contract.crossing_policy: if any stable group has members in both train and validation, members assigned to incompatible timing, or group timing violates purge/embargo, block the entire fold; never move or delete rows
group_contract.identity_scope: operational ticker/timing group; not verified security continuity
group_contract.purge_embargo: recompute after grouping; require every training group label completion/exit before the validation decision boundary and preserve the split plan's one-session embargo
group_contract.source_provenance: retain sorted canonical_observation_ids and their original fold membership
group_contract.stable_group_identity: sha256 of canonical JSON [event_date, uppercase ticker, 5, entry_at, exit_at, sorted canonical_observation_ids]
timing_requirements: every member has finite interpretable event_date, ticker, horizon, entry_at, exit_at, decision_at, and feature_cutoff_at
all members agree on event_date, ticker, horizon, entry_at, exit_at, decision_at, and feature_cutoff_at
every feature source timestamp is <= feature_cutoff_at
timestamps satisfy the established XNYS prediction/execution contract

hypothesis: Training directly on equal-weight ticker/timing-group five-session returns may improve top-five gross endpoint selection relative to the eligible-cohort baseline.
implementation_checklist: verify this registration hash and every frozen input byte/semantic hash
load development IDs only and keep holdout content inaccessible
construct groups and emit row-to-group provenance
run group crossing and timing/purge/embargo gates before fitting
fit training-only preprocessing and exactly one ridge configuration per fold
persist pre-outcome predictions and reproduce mappings before outcome join
score only if every fold remains unblocked
emit all required outputs and no promotion action
known_gaps: cost policy and terminal valuation are unavailable
group-level timing compatibility must be established during a future implementation preflight; any conflict blocks its fold

membership.identities_bound_by: exact split-plan canonical observation ID vectors; no row movement, deletion, or reassignment

model.alpha_meaning: dimensionless L2 coefficient in the explicitly normalized mean-loss objective; newly registered for this regression, not borrowed from classification
model.objective: minimize mean squared error on continuous group return plus alpha times squared standardized-feature coefficients; intercept unpenalized
model.randomness: none; seed serialized for contract completeness
model.solver: closed-form float64 solve of (X'X/n + alpha*I) beta = X'y/n after centering/scaling; use deterministic SVD pseudoinverse with rcond=1e-12 if direct solve is singular

preprocessing.fit_scope: training groups within each fold only
preprocessing.numeric_imputation: per-feature median of nonmissing training-group aggregates
preprocessing.scaling: per-feature training-group mean and population standard deviation after imputation; replace nonfinite or abs(std)<=1e-12 with 1.0
preprocessing.serialization: persist ordered feature list, medians, means, standard deviations, counts, and their canonical JSON SHA-256
preprocessing.unseen_categories: inapplicable because no categorical feature is selected

selection.baseline: same eligible population, equal group weights summing to 1.0; undefined if empty and retained explicitly
selection.empty: retain cohort with cash weight 1.0 and selected gross return 0.0
selection.weights: equal across selected groups and sum to 1.0

target.definition: equal-observation arithmetic mean of member return_5d values from the registered entry_at to exit_at endpoints
target.prediction_semantics: predicted gross split-adjusted five-session group return
